plan.evidence: 2003 Complete Southern Pickets Traverse summary: 'Frenzlespitz, southeast ridge/face, II 5.6'. The 1961 first-ascent account gives the approach (about 500 ft down Ottohorn's north face) but no grade.

body.rock_grade: Up to 5.8 in #2 Gully (mostly low 5th, loose and poorly protected)

plan.evidence: SummitPost South Route: #2 Gully 'steps of varying difficulty ranging from Class 3 to Class 5.8'; crux was 'a short climb of 15 feet between slab and overhang'. A cascadeclimber TR describes several loose fifth-class pitches; Beckey's optional Chimney Variation is 'two leads easy class 5'.

SummitPost North Ridge route page: 'Difficulty: 5.7+ Grade III', seven pitches from the deep notch north of the peak. A 2013 SummitPost TR describes the same seven pitches (friable P1, steep cracks, wide chimney, exposed west-side traverse).

plan.evidence: Trip report on this exact line (South Defile, South Gully, East Ridge): a steep snow finger and gully with deep moats, then the summit is a 'fun Class 2-3 scramble on solid pillow basalt'. No rope used.
